summary: Backend-only verification completed against the public URL. All 17 automated tests pass after an in-scope fix for malformed Ambient session search regexes. Requested flows passed: Meta config masking/persistence, missing-config send guard, webhook GET verification, real Hinglish extraction, automatic session persistence, ordering/search, Ambient/Whisper RBAC and size limit, plus queue/letterhead/feedback regressions. One additional security check failed: the inbound Meta webhook accepts unsigned arbitrary JSON.

critical.issue: Accepts an unauthenticated request with no X-Hub-Signature-256 and returns 200 {received:true}. A forged payload containing messages/statuses would be persisted as trusted webhook data.

action_items: Validate Meta's X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC against the applicable app secret before parsing or persisting inbound webhook payloads; reject missing/invalid signatures with 403.
Encrypt Meta app_secret and long-lived system_user_token at rest rather than persisting plaintext credentials.
Do not silently return a successful Ambient extraction when ambient_sessions persistence fails; make session-log durability observable or transactional/retriable.
critical_code_review_comments: meta_whatsapp.receive_webhook has no signature-verification dependency or header check, so the public endpoint trusts attacker-controlled message/status payloads.
Meta config secrets are stored as plaintext MongoDB fields even though the project has an encryption manager; a database read exposes reusable third-party credentials.
extract_emr catches every ambient_sessions insert error and still returns 200, which can violate the requirement that every successful extraction creates a session row.

The original sessions search passed q directly to MongoDB $regex; q='[' deterministically caused OperationFailure code 51091 and HTTP 500. The test agent fixed this in scope by using shared.safe_regex, and the regression now passes.

success_rate.backend: 94.4% overall (17/17 automated requested/edge tests passed; 1/1 additional unsigned-webhook security check failed). Requested feature acceptance: 100%.

seed_data_creation: Created three isolated TEST doctors, one TEST clinic, assistant/front_desk users, a Meta config, one real LLM Ambient session, and three controlled search rows. All QA users/configs/sessions/clinics were removed; cleanup verification found zero leftovers.
test_credentials: Used the supplied Doctor / Test Professional credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; generated isolated credentials for temporary QA users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Add a negative test for missing/invalid X-Hub-Signature-256 and a positive signed webhook test after signature validation is implemented. The current 17-test suite is green and the real gpt-4o-mini Hinglish extraction completed successfully rather than being quota-blocked.
rca_of_the_issue: Unsigned webhook RCA: receive_webhook reads request.json() immediately and never validates X-Hub-Signature-256 against app_secret, so any public caller gets 200 and can reach persistence loops. Ambient search RCA (fixed): list_sessions inserted raw q as a MongoDB regex; malformed metacharacters such as '[' caused Mongo OperationFailure and an uncaught 500. Escaping q with shared.safe_regex treats user input literally and resolved the failure.
